title: The barn-reeve's shade -- the ghost the Hunger Barn's whole grief quest is about -- has no new dialogue after the grief is bargained, even though I retrieved his own chest, his own order, and used it to strike the bargain in his name. Revisiting shows the identical pre-resolution lines.
